Workflow.Name: SRM Closure - Propose Magna rating from Coface score
Workflow.Description: Agent tool: converts a valid Coface score (within the allowed data age) to a proposed Magna rating with the rating conversion rule table, writes only the preliminary rating, sets the review path, and logs the conversion. It never sets the final rating.
